faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.contact: A question that is not here? Write to

free.a: No. The standard listing is free and complete: key figures, photos, messaging and dashboard. Featured options are optional.

verify.a: Every file goes through moderation before publication: consistency of revenue, profit and asking price, seller identity, photos genuinely related to the business. A rejection always comes with a reason.

commission.q: Do you take a commission on the sale?
commission.a: No commission on the transaction. You negotiate and close directly with the seller or the buyer.

currency.q: Which currencies are prices shown in?
currency.a: In the currency of the listing's country: CFA franc (XOF) for Ivory Coast, Senegal, Benin and Togo, naira (NGN) for Nigeria, cedi (GHS) for Ghana.

account.q: Can I contact a seller without an account?
account.a: No. Messaging requires an account — that is what protects sellers from unserious enquiries.

delay.q: How long before my listing is published?
delay.a: Moderation handles complete files within 48 working hours. An incomplete file is sent back to you with the list of missing items.

cta.title: Create your account in a minute
cta.body: An account gives you access to messaging, listing tracking and view statistics.

footer.about: Find the business to take over in Africa. Verified listings, direct contact, six countries.
